en: "Go and make disciples of all nations."
We call it the Great Commission,
the supreme command.
This great, truly great mission
is what God has given us.

text:
모든 민족으로
제자를 삼는 그 사명이
en: The mission to disciple all nations
wasn't given to missionaries and pastors.

text:
각 *평신도* 한 사람 한 사람에게
주신 소명이라는 것을
en: It's a calling for every single believer —
you need to know that.
Christ died for us
and gave us the Spirit.
But we keep missing this mission,

text:
달라스 윌라드가
*The Great Omission*이라는 책을 썼죠
en: so Dallas Willard wrote The Great Omission.
In Korean it's 'Forgotten Discipleship.'
He took the C out of Commission.
Drop the C from the great mission,
and what's 'omission'? Left out.
A great omission.

text:
왜냐하면 성도들이 온 세상에
복음을 전하고
en: Believers think spreading the gospel
and God's kingdom changing the world
isn't their job, so they leave it out.
And he put it like this:
"There are many vampire Christians."

text:
뱀파이어가 피를 빨아먹는
그런 귀신 같은 존재잖아요
en: A vampire is a creature that sucks blood.
A vampire Christian
sucks only the blood of Christ he needs to be saved
and forgets the mission.

text:
"아, 나 구원받았다
아, 나 천국 받았다"
en: "Ah, I'm saved! Ah, I've got heaven!"

text:
그리스도 피만 빨아먹는
그런 뱀파이어 크리스천들로
en: Sucking only Christ's blood, vampire Christians
have lost their calling.
That's what he said.
